description: Extend shared-cut repair to anti-transposition and keep required single-choice controls connected to their model.

fixedGeometry.method: Run old and current final shared-cut recovery on identical saved geometry and masks, without fitting. Diagnostic deadline is unlimited. The anti fixture is a quarter turn of the committed ordinary hat, including its original mask.

hunodan.method: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

fallback.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

uiFailure.stage: Reselecting an already active Anti button, before any solve; no radio remained checked.

limits: Only unconstrained fitting or one transpose/antiTranspose request is supported by final sharing; combined square and chord symmetries retain their existing exclusion.
The fixed-geometry comparison uses an unlimited diagnostic deadline; production retains its two-second final-sharing allocation inside the overall budget.
Whole-mask fixture error and protected-motif browser error use different targets and denominators.
Timed fresh runs may choose different checkpoints under machine load. The fixed-geometry comparison isolates the changed repair.
Exact common controls guarantee coincidence of the recovered spans; sampled image scores do not prove all possible subpixel seams are absent.
